source_distinction_checks.proposed_text: 6. Then those whose rods were half dry and had cracks handed them in. Many of them handed in green rods without cracks. Some were green with shoots bearing fruit, like the fruit on the rods of the crowned people who had gone into the tower. Some handed in dry and worm-eaten rods; others dry rods that had not been eaten; and others rods just as they had been, half dry and cracked. He ordered each of them to stand separately, some with their own groups and others apart.
source_distinction_checks.rationale: Preserve the explicit contrast between eaten and uneaten rods, and half-dry/cracked rods; do not collapse the comparison into a single generic damaged category.
